Notes

Values of 30, 31 and 32 for TEWHERE were introduced in October 2004 ATUS. Therefore, for (TUMONTH < 10 AND TUYEAR = 2004) these values will not appear. TEWHERE is not collected for activities with activity codes of 0101xx, 0102xx, 0104xx, 500105, or 500106. Files: Activity File (the dictionary's File column).
